name: Sicken Body
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level: vitalist 0

MANIFESTING

Manifesting Time: 1 standard action
Display: olfactory, visual

EFFECT

Range: 30 ft.
Target: 1 living creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; Power Resistance: yes
Power Points: psionic focus or 1

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to be sickened until the start of your next turn unless the creature makes a successful Will save.
